text.tspan: Resize agreement is stage + role agreement
DecisionObserved differs from ActionSettled
GRB01 / common guard snapshot
Old topology / allocator revision / target U / frozen W
Publish NeedChildCollect; no independent branch
GRB02--03 / optional child GC
Old context/root/storage cohort; parent admission
Child ran: acquire common terminal outcome
No child: matching NoChildRequired stage
Queued GC requests remain pending
GRB05 / prepare native contexts and roots
Designated setup actors outside gates
Actual reports / rooted startup data / capacity
Advance only after required actions settle
GRB04 / denial before topology commit
One coherent error path; designated hint rollback
Retain actual post-GC heap / roots / resume state
Never restore old relocated pointers
GRB06 / nonmoving membership cut
Publish new topology and next role roster
Old roles have explicit terminal/custody duties
No exited actor in future quorum
GRB07 / startup and retirement
Creation / Scheme-ready / helper / join facts differ
Keep actors required for startup GC
Unknown or failed join retains real obligations
GRB08 / parent result publication
Actual topology + pending retirement disposition
Error after commit need not mean unchanged
Only represented resize request completes
Each checkpoint
Acquire matching StageId + epoch + role action
Perform outside G / T / C / L
Report ActionSettled before coordinator advance
No timeout invents a departed participant
